Multiple CSS selectors each exclude their matched elements

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	htmd "github.com/xberg-io/html-to-markdown/packages/go/v3"
)

func main() {
	options := htmd.ConversionOptions{
		ExcludeSelectors: []string{`.nav`, `footer`},
	}
	result, err := htmd.Convert(`<body><nav class="nav">Menu</nav><p>Content</p><footer>Footer</footer></body>`, &options)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Content)
}
```
